# BuildEstate — Real Estate Platform

> BuildEstate helps users browse residential and commercial properties across India and schedule property viewings.

## What BuildEstate Is

BuildEstate is a real estate platform serving homebuyers and renters across India. Visitors can browse available flats, villas, apartments, houses, commercial spaces, and plots, then schedule property viewings.

## Core Features

- **Property Browsing**: Search and view available properties across India.
- **Appointment Booking**: Visitors can schedule property viewings through the platform.
- **Admin Dashboard**: Staff manage listings, appointments, and platform activity.

## Cities Covered

Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Ahmedabad, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai

## Property Types

Apartments (1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK+), Villas, Independent Houses, Commercial Spaces, Plots

## Technology

- Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite (hosted on Vercel)
- Backend: Node.js + Express + MongoDB (hosted on Render)
- Property images: ImageKit CDN
